items.title: European shares near record high as earnings absorb tech volatility
items.summary: Investing.com - European shares advanced on Wednesday, pushing the benchmark STOXX 600 within a whisker of a record high, as a resilient corporate earnings season and relief over strong U.S. artificial intelligence demand offset lingering anxiety over a hawkish repricing of Federal Reserve interest-rate expectations.

items.title: Eneos raises FY profit forecast by ~50% on stronger oil markets
items.summary: Investing.com-- Japan's Eneos Holdings (TYO:5020) raised its full-year profit forecast by nearly 50% on Wednesday, as stronger crude oil prices and favourable overseas petroleum product markets boosted earnings, offsetting impairment losses in its renewable energy business.

items.title: Can Colgate-Palmolive (CL) Justify Its Price Following Raised 2026 Guidance?
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive (CL) has paired a raised 2026 outlook with fresh third quarter numbers, giving investors updated visibility on expected net sales growth, margins and earnings per share this year. The raised 2026 guidance and third quarter update come on top of strong recent momentum, with Colgate-Palmolive’s share price up 11.12% over the past month and delivering a 26.26% year-to-date share price return, while the 5-year total shareholder return of 41.85% points to a steadier long-term...

items.title: Oil prices stabilize as Hormuz attacks dent Middle East peace hopes
items.summary: Investing.com - Oil prices steadied on Wednesday after crude slipped to a two-month low in the prior session, as attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz dented emerging hopes for a de-escalation in the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

items.title: Bank of Canada signals more rate hikes may come despite uncertainty
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of Canada officials indicated that uncertainties from higher oil prices and the trade war with the United States will not necessarily prevent additional interest rate increases, according to deliberations from their October meeting released Tuesday.

items.title: US oil output to reach record 13.9 million bpd in 2026
items.summary: Investing.com -- US crude production is projected to reach 13.9 million barrels per day in 2026, marking the fourth consecutive year of record output, the Energy Information Administration said Tuesday.

items.title: European gas prices hit 1-month lows as Trump pauses Iran strikes
items.summary: Investing.com - European wholesale natural gas prices slipped to one-month lows on Tuesday, tracking a relentless deflationary wave across the broader energy complex as U.S. President Donald Trump dialed back the threat of further military strikes against Iran and brokered fresh peace talks between Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: European shares climb on oil relief, shaking off hot U.S. CPI print
items.summary: Investing.com - European equities advanced on Tuesday, with the benchmark STOXX 600 climbing 0.3% to edge closer to a fresh record high.
